params.prompt: Create a NEW NARRATIVE CUTSCENE inside the warehouse from reference1. NOT the same overview, NOT an edited copy of the warehouse map. Use a closer three-quarter camera at chest height showing a worker and parcel in an aisle, with warehouse environment behind. Reference1 is the strict RENDERING STYLE target: finely rendered dimensional illustrated game art, smooth material gradients, soft reflected daylight, gently shaded blue metal racks, warm cardboard with subtle volume, thin muted grey edges rather than bold black linework. Reference2 reinforces the quality of faces and clothing: appealing expressive adult face, detailed soft folds, restrained linework. Do NOT turn into flat vector/cartoon panels, cel-shaded comic, line drawing, or photorealism. Narrative: parcel left at receiving now needs a separate long trip to dispatch. One alert pleasant adult warehouse employee in orange-and-navy uniform and orange safety cap pushes a small wheeled platform trolley with ONE closed kraft gift carton. Both hands naturally on handle. Worker and trolley are the central subject, occupy middle 45 percent of image, fully visible from head to wheels, worker about half image height. Worker is actively walking rightward, neutral engaged expression, no exhaustion or sadness. Receiving blue shutter visible to left; a long aisle of blue/orange racks recedes toward dispatch in right background, giving a clear sense of distance. Cream walls, large daylight windows, grey floor with yellow lanes. Keep foreground action centered around y50 percent, lower 20 percent mostly floor. No giant character overlay, no diagram, no arrows, no UI, no text, no brand logos. Match reference1 soft volume and polished material detail meticulously; character must belong naturally in that same world. This is a cinematic consequence vignette, not a warehouse layout map.
